mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exception_case AS existing ( exception_key, exception_type, severity, status, validation_run_id, contract_id, agent_id, policy_version_id, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, title, description ) VALUES ( #{exceptionKey}, #{exceptionType}, #{severity}, 'NEW', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, #{agentId}, #{policyVersionId}, 'COMMISSION_TRANSACTION', CAST(#{paymentId} AS varchar), #{title}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (exception_key) DO UPDATE SET exception_type = EXCLUDED.exception_type, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE existing.status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT policy_version_id FROM cap_rule_set WHERE cap_rule_set_id = #{capRuleSetId}
